title: Honey Mustard Marinade
steps: Whisk everything together. Set aside a few spoonfuls for glazing later.
Add the chicken, turn to coat, cover or seal in a zip-top bag and refrigerate for 1 to 8 hours.
## Bake: on lined pan, no rack
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Line a rimmed sheet pan with parchment or foil. Honey drips burn on a bare pan, and a rack lets them smoke.

Lay the chicken in a single layer, skin-side up, with the marinade that clings to it, and bake: bone-in thighs or drumsticks 35–45 min, boneless breast 18–24 min. Brush with the reserved marinade for the last 10 minutes. Tent with foil if it browns too fast. Done at 165°F (74°C) for breast, 175°F (79°C) or more for thighs and drumsticks. Rest 5 minutes.
Grill over medium heat; the honey browns quickly.
Never reuse marinade that has touched raw chicken. For basting or sauce, set some aside before adding the chicken.
